visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short brown hair and straight bangs stands in a brightly lit indoor room with a plain white wall and light-colored wooden flooring. She is initially wearing a white camisole and tight black athletic shorts, holding a bundle of folded clothes consisting of a brown knit sweater and black pants. She smiles directly at the camera while adjusting the items in her arms. (2) Following a quick jump cut, she is now wearing the brown cable-knit V-neck sweater and black flared denim jeans. She points upward with one hand and winks, then proceeds to fasten a brown leather belt around her waist. She puts on a green New Era baseball cap and a silver beaded necklace, finally holding up a pair of white and silver athletic sneakers to the camera. (3) The scene shifts as she reveals a new outfit: a beige and navy zip-up windbreaker jacket paired with a long, brown and black plaid midi skirt. She adjusts the collar of the jacket and puts on a tan baseball cap featuring a 'Mardi' logo. Her expression is cheerful as she poses with a peace sign and adjusts the jacket's hem. (4) In the next visual phase, she transitions into a white off-the-shoulder long-sleeve top adorned with a large black bow on the left shoulder, paired with blue denim jeans and a grey 'LA' baseball cap. She carries a large black quilted shoulder bag. She poses by crossing her arms and smiling, showcasing the fit and accessories under the flat, even indoor lighting. (5) For the final reveal, she layered a thick, oversized grey textured zip-up coat over the previous white top. She stands at a medium distance, turning slightly to show the silhouette of the jacket. She eventually waves goodbye to the camera, maintaining a friendly and energetic demeanor throughout the sequence.
